checks.ck_bsesi_base: deleted=0 AND version>=0 AND observation_epoch>=0 AND source_fence_revision>0 AND attempt_no=1
checks.ck_bsesi_route: (route_no IS NULL AND route_hash IS NULL) OR (route_no IS NOT NULL AND route_hash IS NOT NULL)
checks.ck_bsesi_route_no: route_no IS NULL OR route_no REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
checks.ck_bsesi_route_hash: route_hash IS NULL OR route_hash REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
checks.ck_bsesi_evidence_hash: evidence_hash IS NULL OR evidence_hash REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
checks.ck_bsesi_receipt_hash: receipt_hash IS NULL OR receipt_hash REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_execution_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.executionNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.executionNo'))=execution_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_task_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.taskNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.taskNo'))=task_no

checks.ck_bsesi_ref_reference_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.referenceHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.referenceHash'))=reference_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_lookup_retention_no: JSON_EXTRACT(lookup_json, '$.retentionNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(lookup_json, '$.retentionNo'))=retention_no
checks.ck_bsesi_lookup_request_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(lookup_json, '$.requestHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(lookup_json, '$.requestHash'))=request_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_fence_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.sourceFenceNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.sourceFenceNo'))=fence_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_attempt_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.attemptNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.attemptNo'))=attempt_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_binding_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.bindingHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.bindingHash'))=binding_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_source_intent_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.sourceIntentHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.sourceIntentHash'))=source_intent_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_resource_command_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.plannedResourceCommandNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.plannedResourceCommandNo'))=resource_command_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_resource_command_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.plannedResourceCommandHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.plannedResourceCommandHash'))=resource_command_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_plan_hash: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.planHash') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.planHash'))=plan_hash
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_tenant_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.tenantNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.tenantNo'))=tenant_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_entity_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.entityNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.entityNo'))=entity_no
checks.ck_bsesi_ref_store_no: JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.storeNo') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(reference_json, '$.scope.storeNo'))=store_no

triggers.name: trg_bsesi_immutable
triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT (BINARY NEW.id <=> BINARY OLD.id) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_at <=> BINARY OLD.created_at) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_by <=> BINARY OLD.created_by) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.store_no <=> BINARY OLD.store_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.work_order_no <=> BINARY OLD.work_order_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.task_no <=> BINARY OLD.task_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.fence_no <=> BINARY OLD.fence_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.submission_no <=> BINARY OLD.submission_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_no <=> BINARY OLD.execution_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.resource_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.attempt_no <=> BINARY OLD.attempt_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.binding_hash <=> BINARY OLD.binding_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.source_intent_hash <=> BINARY OLD.source_intent_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_command_hash <=> BINARY OLD.resource_command_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.plan_hash <=> BINARY OLD.plan_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.reference_hash <=> BINARY OLD.reference_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.lookup_hash <=> BINARY OLD.lookup_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.retention_no <=> BINARY OLD.retention_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.request_hash <=> BINARY OLD.request_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.reference_json <=> BINARY OLD.reference_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.lookup_json <=> BINARY OLD.lookup_json) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Manual execution immutable original';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.route_no IS NOT NULL AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.route_no <=> BINARY OLD.route_no) OR NOT (BINARY NEW.route_hash <=> BINARY OLD.route_hash)) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Execution stock route is sticky';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.observation_epoch<>OLD.observation_epoch+1 OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR OLD.observation_epoch>=9223372036854775806 OR OLD.version>=9223372036854775806 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Execution stock observation CAS required';
    END IF;
END
